hero.title: Your trusted taxi
hero.subtitle: Punctuality, comfort, and a personal touch. We take you wherever you need to go, from Teià to any destination.

services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: We tailor every service to your needs. Available 24/7, 7 days a week.

airports.title: Ports & Airports
airports.description: We take you to the airport or cruise port so you don't have to worry about parking. When you return, we'll be waiting to take you home.

trains.title: Train & Bus Stations
trains.description: Whether you're catching a commuter train, high-speed rail, or a long-distance bus, we'll get you there on time.

local.title: Local Services
local.description: Errands, shopping, pharmacy, bank, town hall... We accompany you on your daily tasks, comfortably and on time.

longDistance.title: Long Distance
longDistance.description: Travel without rushing. We pick you up at your door and take you to your destination while you relax and enjoy the journey.

medical.title: Medical & Hospitals
medical.description: For medical or hospital visits, we wait at the door to take you back home whenever you're ready.

packages.title: Packages & Documents
packages.description: Urgent or relaxed delivery of documents and packages. We handle your items with the utmost care and professionalism.

car.title: The Car
car.subtitle: Toyota Corolla Hybrid 2026 — Comfort, safety and style for every journey.

overview.title: Elegant Design
overview.description: The new Toyota Corolla blends a modern, aerodynamic design with the brand's legendary reliability. Perfect for any journey, short or long.

trunk.title: Generous Boot
trunk.description: 361-litre boot. Two large suitcases and your carry-on fit with ease. Travel comfortably without worrying about space.

doors.title: Comfortable Interior
doors.description: Spacious interior with ergonomic seats, dual-zone climate control, Bluetooth connectivity and USB charging. Every ride is a pleasure.

hood.title: Hybrid Engine
hood.description: 2.0 HEV Hybrid engine, 196 HP. Efficient, quiet and eco-friendly. Lower emissions, more miles, and a quieter ride for all passengers.

booking.title: Book your ride
booking.subtitle: Tell us where you're going first. We'll estimate the trip, then you pick any time that fits.
